title: MeshStream
oneLiner: Live video streaming where the viewers become the CDN.
claim: Turns concurrent viewers into a self-organising P2P mesh, so the origin server stops carrying every byte.

metrics: WHIP ingest (RFC 9725) over UDP, transmuxed to low-latency HLS with no transcoding step
16 KB DataChannel chunks with SCTP backpressure and a bounded in-memory LRU segment cache
Every resolved byte is counted as p2pBytes or httpBytes, so the offload ratio is measured rather than claimed
Bounded peer-set selection keeps the swarm k-regular instead of exploding into a full mesh
proof.architecture: A broadcaster ingests with WHIP into MediaMTX, which transmuxes to LL-HLS. A WebSocket tracker hands each viewer a bounded set of peers and relays SDP and ICE. A custom hls.js loader then races the swarm against the origin for every segment and falls back to HTTP the moment a peer misses the playback deadline.
